text: A useful memory candidate must satisfy three properties: (1) NOVELTY — the knowledge is not already present in the semantic memory corpus, (2) SITUATION-SPECIFIC — it captures a concrete failure, fix, or decision rather than generic trivia, and (3) NON-RECONSTRUCTIBLE — it cannot be trivially regenerated by the LLM from the system prompt or existing context. Candidates that fail any of these criteria should be rejected at the validation gate before staging.
